request_work_unit: request the next work unit from the orchestrator server for a given robot job
complete_work_unit: complete the current work unit with an outcome, success score, and optional session info
start_work_unit_execution: start the execution stage for the current work unit on the orchestrator server
insert_session_info: insert session info including log type, start and end timestamps for the current work unit
observe_latest_work_unit: observe the latest work unit for a given job type and robot ID
